# hazard bearer

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hazardBearer`](gmeow-hazardBearer.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hazardBearer>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/risk`](../../slices/risk.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The entity in which this hazard inheres. Functional and mandatory (SHACL): a disposition has exactly one bearer ([gUFO](../../external/ontologies.md#target-gufo) inherence, asserted with GMEOW's own property — [Principle 5](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-5)). The same danger borne by two systems is two hazards.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Hazard`](../classes/gmeow-Hazard.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hazardBearer`](gmeow-hazardBearer.md) from [`gmeow:Hazard`](../classes/gmeow-Hazard.md) to [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
